coin.description: bright rising blip: coin or collectible picked up

gem.description: glassy chime: gem, crystal or rare item picked up

power-up.description: rising synth sweep: power-up or boost

point.description: short confirm blip: point scored, checkpoint, correct

countdown-tick.description: single beep: each second of a countdown

start.description: three rising tones: go, round start

time-up.description: falling buzz: time up, round over

open.description: short rise: panel or menu opens

close.description: short fall: panel or menu closes

jump.description: springy rising zip: jump, bounce pad

land.description: soft heavy thud: landing, something dropped

splat.description: wet squelch: slime, goo, closest to a splash

teleport.description: rising phaser sweep: teleport, portal, respawn

lever.description: metal latch clack: lever, switch, lock

explosion.description: deep boom: explosion, cannon, big impact

fire-loop.description: roaring flame: fire, lava, furnace, jet

rumble-loop.description: low engine rumble: machinery, cave, earthquake

machine-loop.description: busy electronic chatter: computer room, lab, generator, machine
